Resolve the four forces in two perpendicular directions — M1.

Obtain the correct signed horizontal component — A1.

Obtain the correct signed vertical component — A1.

Use $S=\sqrt{X^2+Y^2}$ — DM1.

Use $\tan\alpha=Y/X$ with the correct quadrant — DM1.

$S=22.5\,\mathrm{N}$ and $\alpha=37.7^\circ$ — A1. Accept $37.8^\circ$.

Total: 6
